_comment: Trap catalog. Cells reference these by id via the cell's trap_id field (placed in the map editor's Cell Inspector). trap_type picks the resolution branch: 'damage' rolls damage_range against the victim(s); 'effect' applies the effects.json record in `effect` (damage traps may ALSO carry an effect — it rides along on a failed save); 'teleport' moves the party to params.teleport {map_id, col, row}. params.targets: 'one' (random alive member, default) or 'all'. params.save_stat + params.save_dc give victims a d20 + stat-modifier save — pass = half damage and no effect. Legacy boolean trap cells (and procedural dungeon traps) resolve to 'dart_trap'.

traps.name: Dart Trap
traps.description: A spring-loaded dart fires from a hidden housing. The default trap — legacy trap cells and procedural dungeon traps resolve to this record.

traps.name: Fire Trap
traps.description: A glyph of searing flame that engulfs the whole party when tripped.

traps.name: Teleport Trap
traps.description: A translocation glyph that hurls the party elsewhere. Sample record — point params.teleport at your module's destination cell.
